meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native workflow tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一次调用让多个AI助手按依赖关系协同作业
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有需要分步完成、且步骤间有先后依赖的复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent AI subtasks together in a single workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big task that can be split into dependent subtasks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一个多步骤任务按依赖关系拆成子代理节点图,一次跑完;先并行执行无依赖的节点,再推进后续节点,过程中会检查节点是否越界,并在目标核实通过前不把完成结果当真。
howto.when: 当用户提出“mass-ulw”、任务 DAG 或扇出/扇入式的多代理执行,且部分任务必须等其它任务完成时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这三件事按依赖排成 DAG,一次跑完。
say.note: 它会生成并运行节点图,先跑可并行的部分。

say.text: 写个多代理任务:先调研,再写正文,最后校对,每步等前一步。
say.note: 它会按依赖构建图并分批并行执行。

say.text: 帮我重跑刚才那个失败节点,并改一下它的提示词。
say.note: 它会用新提示对那个节点发起重试。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs child agents as a dependency DAG in one go: it plans the graph, executes independent nodes in parallel as dependencies clear, monitors for scope drift, and treats completion as false until proved by success criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn these three steps into a DAG with dependencies and run it at once.
say_en.note: It will build and run the node graph, starting independent nodes.

say_en.text: Create a multi-agent task: research, then write, then proofread, each waiting on the previous.
say_en.note: It will build the dependency graph and execute in waves.

say_en.text: Retry that failed node with an updated prompt.
say_en.note: It will retry the node with the new instruction.
